caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of black lace fabric centered on a light beige or off-white background. The lace features a repeating floral pattern consisting of large, detailed flowers and leaves arranged densely throughout the fabric. The floral motifs are rendered in dark black, with some areas featuring lighter dots or mesh to indicate gaps or transparency in the lace. The background of the lace, visible between the floral shapes, consists of a fine mesh or netting pattern. The bottom edge of the lace is scalloped, following the contours of the floral design. At the top of the image, straight lines form a triangular hanger-like shape, with measurements labeled as "22" and "14," indicating dimensions in an unspecified unit. The lace and its pattern occupy almost the entire height and width of the image, except for a thin border of background along the sides and top. Small rust-colored spots are present on the background outside the lace, mostly near the corners.
title: Embroidered Lace
